spec_family.name: Bare Drywall — New Construction — Prime (Walls + Ceilings)
spec_family.description: Prime coat(s) for new construction bare drywall on walls and ceilings as a single workflow. Covers surface prep for priming, dust control, spot/surface conditioning, and application via spray and/or backroll/roll. Does not include finish coats; walls and ceiling finishes are separate spec families.

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier affects inspection rigor and defect correction rounds prior to and after prime.
Whether the surface is wall or ceiling (both can be included in this prime workflow).
Drywall finish level impacts prep and defect correction expectations.
Jobsite condition affects protection and dust management.
Primer selection strategy based on performance needs.

paintable_items.name: Bare Drywall Wall Area
paintable_items.counting_rules: Measure wall surface area in square feet. Exclude openings/deductions per estimating policy.
paintable_items.notes: New construction measurement often comes from plans or takeoff tools.

paintable_items.name: Bare Drywall Ceiling Area
paintable_items.counting_rules: Measure ceiling surface area in square feet.
paintable_items.notes: Vaulted/angled ceilings should be measured on surface plane where feasible.

variants.notes: Default new construction prime using PVA drywall primer; assumes acceptable drywall finish quality for chosen level.
Higher performance prime option when substrate/finish expectations demand more build and surface uniformity.

assumptions: Drywall is installed and finished to the declared level prior to priming.
This spec includes priming workflow only (no finish coats).
Major drywall repairs are excluded; minor touch-ups/defects are included as defined in SOP modules.
exclusions: Texture application or knockdown/orange peel processes
Major drywall repair beyond minor patch/touch-up
